verdict.rationale: Data residency is a fair question for a cloud-hosted compliance SaaS, so the axis applies. The pack never documents a customer choice of storage region. The only related signal is an API Playground note that the explorer is hosted on "live regional apps (e.g. https://eu.sprinto.com/...)". That implies regional instances but says nothing about letting customers select where their data is stored, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
